home.profile: I develop and build web applications on both the backend and the frontend. I work on products from the first architectural decisions through to deployment. I'm comfortable with systems based on microservices, as well as modulith and monolithic architectures. On my own initiative, I propose and implement solutions that have a real impact on the stability and performance of the product.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: I develop web applications across both backend and frontend. I mainly work on systems already running in production: adding new features, refactoring existing code, and ensuring the whole system remains stable. I have co-created a product from the first architectural decisions through deployment. I have been programming for five years, including one year professionally.

shelfio.title: Full-stack software developer
shelfio.body: I'm responsible for maintaining and developing areas critical to store operations, along with other key functionality. I also build web applications that form a shared product layer for autonomous stores and gyms. On my own initiative, I introduced changes that improved performance and UX. I design, build and develop individual services.

sitebell.title: Front-end developer · internship
sitebell.body: I was responsible for developing and shipping new UI components. I took part in daily team meetings and proposed and built my own solutions, which had a real impact on the final look of the product.

technology.description: The tools I use to build, ship, and maintain production web applications on both the frontend and backend.
